svg.title: MuseArena architecture
svg.desc: The console sends a prompt to the designer, which Muse Spark drives. The approved spec goes to Supabase. The worker claims it, builds the lab on QEMU, configures it, runs the gates and the exercise, and writes the score, traces and dataset back to Supabase. The learning API builds datasets and runs training and evaluation. Pipeline: design, approve, provision, configure, gates, exercise, score, publish, learn.
